name: food-safety-chain
description: Decentralized Food Safety Assurance via Blockchain with Smart Contracts (MERN + Solidity)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run setup && concurrently -k -n chain,api,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm:chain" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && npm run deploy && npm run backend" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5000 && npm run frontend"
